description: A wide 16:9 concept diagram titled nothing, showing the two places a language model can know something from. LEFT half, labelled at top 'Learned in training': a stack of grey document sheets labelled 'Public text, up to the training cutoff' with an arrow labelled 'training (months, once)' pointing right into a large rounded box labelled 'Model weights' with a small padlock and the caption 'frozen after training'. Below it, a faded dashed document labelled 'Rasoi's Purchase Policy (private, 2026)' with a red-orange cross on the arrow, caption 'never seen'. RIGHT half, labelled at top 'Read on this call': a long horizontal strip divided into three segments labelled 'system prompt', 'Rasoi's clauses', 'Kavita's question', and the strip is labelled 'Context window: the only working memory'. An arrow from the strip goes into the same 'Model weights' box (shared in the middle) and an arrow out of the box points to a speech-bubble-shaped rounded rectangle labelled 'Answer'. The 'Rasoi's clauses' segment is highlighted sky blue. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 comparison diagram with three columns of equal width, side by side, each a rounded card with a heading and a small schematic. Column 1 heading 'Fine-tune': schematic of documents flowing into a box labelled 'training run' that outputs a box labelled 'new weights'; three short lines under it: 'slow and costly', 'stale at the next amendment', 'cannot cite a clause'. Column 2 heading 'Paste everything': schematic of all eight documents stacked into one long prompt strip labelled 'whole corpus, every question'; lines under it: 'simple', 'pays for every page, every time', 'everyone sees everything'. Column 3 heading 'Retrieve': schematic of many small chunks with four highlighted in sky blue being lifted into a short prompt strip labelled 'only the clauses that answer'; lines under it: 'small prompt', 'cites its sources', 'respects who may read what'. Column 3 card has a sky-blue outline, columns 1 and 2 grey outlines. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 pipeline diagram in two horizontal lanes. TOP lane, labelled on the left 'Once, when documents change': three boxes left to right connected by arrows: 'Documents (8 files)' then 'Chunk by section (one clause each)' then a box that splits into two stacked boxes 'Keyword index (BM25)' and 'Vector index (embeddings)'. BOTTOM lane, labelled on the left 'Every question': boxes left to right connected by arrows: 'Question' then 'Search query' then two stacked boxes 'BM25 top 20' and 'Vector top 20' (each fed by a dotted arrow from the matching index above) then 'Fuse the two lists (RRF)' then 'Rerank (cross-encoder)' then 'Top 4 clauses' then 'Prompt' then 'Model' then 'Answer with citations' then 'Check citations'. The boxes 'Top 4 clauses' and 'Answer with citations' are sky blue; others white with grey outline. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 diagram with two panels side by side. LEFT panel heading 'Embedding model (search)': two separate input boxes on the left, 'Question' and 'Clause', each with its own arrow into its own encoder box labelled 'encoder', each encoder outputs a vertical bar of small cells labelled '384 numbers'; the two bars meet at a circle labelled 'cosine' which outputs '0.68'. Caption under the panel: 'Each text is turned into numbers on its own. Clauses can be done in advance.' RIGHT panel heading 'Reranker (cross-encoder)': one input box containing both 'Question' and 'Clause' side by side joined by a plus sign, one arrow into one larger box labelled 'encoder reads both together', output a single box labelled 'score'. Caption under the panel: 'Reads the pair together. Slower, so only for the top 20.' Sky blue accents on the encoders. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 diagram with two horizontal rows. TOP row, labelled on the left 'LLM wiki: compile once': 'Documents' arrow to 'Model writes pages (one per topic, every rule cited)' arrow to a small grid of six page tiles labelled 'Wiki pages' with thin link lines between tiles, plus one tile labelled 'Index (one line per page)'; a small check box beside them labelled 'Lint: citations exist, links resolve'. Under the row a second line, 'At question time:' with boxes 'Read the index' arrow 'Pick up to 3 pages' arrow 'Answer'. BOTTOM row, labelled on the left 'RAG: search every time': 'Documents' arrow 'Chunks (one clause each)' arrow 'Search' arrow 'Top 4 clauses' arrow 'Answer'. Under it a small note 'No model work until a question arrives'. Top row accents green, bottom row accents sky blue. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 diagram with two rows comparing where a permission filter goes. TOP row heading 'Filter first (right)': a box 'All chunks: 251' arrow into a funnel labelled 'Kavita's clearance: all staff, purchase' arrow into a box 'Kavita's index: 247' arrow 'Search' arrow 'Context window' arrow 'Answer'. Beside the funnel, four small red-orange tiles labelled 'HR salary bands' are stopped and set aside with the label 'never indexed for her'. BOTTOM row heading 'Filter the answer afterwards (wrong)': 'All chunks: 251' arrow 'Search' arrow 'Context window' where one red-orange tile labelled 'HR salary bands' sits inside the context window, arrow 'Answer' then a filter icon labelled 'too late: the model has read it'. Top row in sky blue accents, bottom row with red-orange warning accents. Labels as plain text, no brackets.
